name: BoundedGS
definition: A bounded-working-set execution method for high-resolution 3DGS training that separates rasterization and projection backward passes to allow local state release after gradient contribution collection, using candidate-indexed projection and compact gradient storage to limit active memory.
summary: BoundedGS is a memory-efficient 3D Gaussian Splatting method that bounds GPU memory by separating rasterization and projection backward passes and using group-based candidate screening.
